widget_mechanic: Compose: calendar must advance to depart-target month AND return must be set ≥ depart in correct order.

source_inspiration.instruction: Book a flight with AirAsia from Hong Kong to Manila leaving August 7 and coming back August 14. If there are no available flights for those dates, please show evidence and indicate this in your answer. Any other blocker is considered a failure.
source_inspiration.first_failure_summary: [1.4] Wrong values or constraint violation: The agent never set the required dates (Aug 7 depart, Aug 14 return). The form remained on different prefilled dates (shown in evidence as May 17–20, 2026).

ui_pattern_description: Two-month side-by-side calendar with shared prev/next nav (depart then return)
